model_annotation: The bar chart displays the negative log probability for various medical specialties, with the model "Mistralv0.2-Base" fine-tuned on different specialty domains. The x-axis represents the per-specialty terms, including Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The y-axis shows the negative log probability, ranging from -22 to -27. Each specialty has a set of bars, with different colors representing the fine-tuned models: a light blue bar for "Mistralv0.2-Base" and various shades of orange and brown for the fine-tuned models on different specialties. The bars for each specialty are grouped together, and the length of each bar corresponds to the negative log probability value. The chart shows that the negative log probability varies across different specialties and models, with some models having higher probabilities than others for specific specialties.
